text_sections.label: Special Digivolution Condition
text_sections.text: [App Fusion] [Logamon] & [Timemon]: Cost 0 If 2 such cards are linked together, stack the link card on top and digivolve.

text_sections.label: Effect
text_sections.text: ＜Jamming＞ [On Play] [When Digivolving] [When Attacking] If it's your turn, you may link 1 [Social], [Tool] or [Game] trait Digimon card from your trash or this Digimon's digivolution cards to this Digimon with the cost reduced by 2. [All Turns] [Once Per Turn] When this Digimon gets linked, 1 of your opponent's Digimon or Tamers can't digivolve until their turn ends.

text_sections.label: Link Condition
text_sections.text: ＜Link＞ [Appmon] trait: Cost 3 (Plug this card from the hand or battle area sideways into the specified Digimon in the battle area.)

text_sections.label: Link Effect
text_sections.text: [When Linking] 2 of your opponent's Digimon or Tamers can't unsuspend until their turn ends.
